function.name: get_availability
function.description: Find more arrival windows after triage, e.g. 'anything later?', 'mornings only', 'do you have Saturday?', 'can you come on the 28th?'. Returns up to 3 offered_slots with spoken labels, a scheduling_note when the requested day can't be offered (weekdays_only, beyond_booking_horizon, date_passed), and a say field with the next step.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the service address, e.g. 11372.

urgency.description: urgent if triage said book_earliest, otherwise routine.

preferred_date.description: A specific date the caller asked for, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 'the 28th', 'next month'). The result says honestly if it's a weekend, past the two-week booking window, or already passed.

after.description: ISO timestamp; only windows starting after this. Use the last offered starts_at for 'anything later'.

customer_id.description: customer_id from lookup_customer, if found (members get first pick).
